items.body: A bright orange astronaut fancy dress for kids, cut like a launch-day flight suit. The zip-front suit has long sleeves with elastic cuffs, an elastic waist and gathered ankles, and two royal blue patches on the chest stand in for the control panels of a real space suit. A boxy orange hood frames the face like a helmet, so the child is still easy to see and hear on stage. It suits a space or science theme day at school, a community helpers or "what I want to be" fancy dress competition, and a speech about Kalpana Chawla, Sunita Williams or India's Gaganyaan mission. Pair it with white sneakers, as in the photo, and your young astronaut is ready for lift-off. Tell us your child's age when you book and we will set aside the right size.
